LanguageData.Spell_ArcsRay.description: While chanting, gathers an unerring arrow of light. When the cast ends, it is loosed at the chosen enemy, piercing enemies and buildings along its path until it strikes home (ignoring armor and damage multipliers)
LanguageData.Spell_ArcsRay.label: Arcs Ray
LanguageData.Spell_Explosion.description: Once the incantation ends, sets off a huge explosion at the target point whose damage and radius scale with spell power. Afterwards the caster is left paralyzed for hours by mana exhaustion
LanguageData.Spell_Explosion.label: Explosion
LanguageData.Spell_FusilladeFlameSpears.description: Locks onto enemies within a cone while chanting, then looses flame spears that bombard the area around them when the cast ends
LanguageData.Spell_FusilladeFlameSpears.label: Fusillade Flame Spears
LanguageData.Spell_KingsSword.description: Summons a greatsword that hovers and circles around the caster, attacking nearby enemies on its own. Casting it again while it is active extends its duration and doubles its attack range and damage
LanguageData.Spell_KingsSword.label: King's Sword
LanguageData.Spell_LightGuard.description: Once the incantation ends, summons several light spirits to circle the caster, absorbing incoming projectiles and burning nearby enemies. The number of spirits and the duration are affected by spell power
LanguageData.Spell_LightGuard.label: Guardian Light Spirits
LanguageData.Spell_LuminousWind.description: Summons several wind bolts while chanting that automatically seek out nearby enemies when the cast ends
LanguageData.Spell_LuminousWind.label: Luminous Wind
LanguageData.Spell_NoahHeal.description: Bandages all wounds, which then heal faster for a time
LanguageData.Spell_NoahHeal.label: Noah Heal
LanguageData.Spell_TheWorld.description: Unfolds a field of stalled time, in which the time of everything but its caster comes to a stop
LanguageData.Spell_ThunderStorm.description: Turns the weather into a violent storm, calling down several large lightning strikes on random enemies across the map
LanguageData.Spell_ThunderStorm.label: Thunder Storm
LanguageData.Spell_ZeoGullveig.description: Once the incantation ends, unfolds a healing circle at the target point that bandages wounds, heals injuries and suppresses pain for allies within it
LanguageData.Spell_ZeoGullveig.label: Blessing of the Goddess of Rebirth
